title: A differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3D Gaussian Splatting-SPH model for forward simulation and inverse analysis in solid mechanics
title_zh: 一种用于固体力学正向模拟与逆分析的微分可导拉格朗日耦合三维高斯泼溅-SPH模型

paragraphs.en: A differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3D Gaussian Splatting–SPH model for forward simulation and inverse analysis in solid mechanics
paragraphs.zh: 一种用于固体力学正向模拟与逆分析的可微拉格朗日耦合三维高斯泼溅–SPH模型

paragraphs.en: Tian Xu, Soroush Atashi, Tianju Xue ∗ 1 1 1 Corresponding author: Tianju Xue. Email: cetxue@ust.hk
paragraphs.zh: Tian Xu、Soroush Atashi、Tianju Xue ∗ 1 1 1 通讯作者：Tianju Xue。电子邮件：cetxue@ust.hk

paragraphs.en: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
paragraphs.zh: 香港科技大学土木与环境工程系

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in generative world models for physical artificial intelligence have increased interest in digital models that reproduce both the appearance of real objects and their response to physical interaction. Three-dimensional reconstruction techniques, including 3D Gaussian Splatting, capture detailed surface geometry and appearance from images and videos, while physics-integrated representations extend these capabilities to simulating the mechanical response of deformable solids. However, extending these representations beyond plausible animation to mechanically interpretable models for constitutive behavior, boundary conditions, and inverse parameter identification remains less explored. In this work, a differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)–smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) model is proposed for forward simulation and inverse analysis of deformable solids. The observed object is first reconstructed from multi-view calibrated visual dataset as a 3DGS rendering model. An envelope-based procedure then generates an independent SPH support for the solid-mechanics model, avoiding the direct use of rendering primitives as mechanical particles. A reference-configuration Lagrangian transfer maps SPH deformation to Gaussian positions and covariances, thereby coupling the physical model and the image observation model while preserving a differentiable computational path. The SPH formulation supports linear elastic, hyperelastic, and Kelvin–Voigt viscoelastic responses, together with fixed, free, and Robin-type boundary conditions. Numerical studies validate the SPH response against finite-element results, assess accuracy and efficiency against a conventional model using Gaussian centers as surface SPH particles, and demonstrate forward simulations on beam, bridge, and liver-shaped examples. Inverse analyses further estimate constitutive and boundary parameters from rendered deformation observations, including noisy cases, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed model for mechanics-based parameter identification from image data.
paragraphs.zh: 物理人工智能领域生成式世界模型的最新进展，提升了对能够再现真实物体外观及其对物理交互响应的数字模型的兴趣。 三维重建技术（包括3D高斯泼溅）可从图像和视频中提取详细的表面几何结构与外观，而集成物理的表示方法则将这些能力扩展至可变形固体的力学响应模拟。 然而，如何将这些表示方法从可信的动画范围进一步拓展为能够解释材料本构行为、边界条件及反参数识别的力学模型，仍是一个研究较少的领域。 本研究提出了一种可微分的拉格朗日耦合3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）–光滑粒子流体动力学（SPH）模型，用于可变形固体的正向模拟与反向分析。 首先，通过多视角校准的视觉数据集将观测到的物体重建为一个3DGS渲染模型。 随后，一种基于包络面的方法为固体力学模型生成独立的SPH支撑结构，从而避免直接使用渲染原语作为力学粒子。 参考构型下的拉格朗日传递将SPH形变映射到高斯位置与协方差上，从而在保持可微分计算路径的同时，耦合了物理模型与图像观测模型。 该SPH公式支持线弹性、超弹性和凯尔文–沃伊特黏弹性响应，并兼容固定、自由及罗宾型边界条件。 数值研究通过有限元结果验证了SPH的响应表现，并与以高斯中心作为表面SPH粒子的传统模型相比，评估了其准确性与效率；同时展示了在梁、桥梁和肝脏形状示例上的正向模拟结果。 反向分析进一步从渲染出的形变观测数据中估计材料本构参数与边界条件（包括含噪声的情况），证明了该模型在基于图像数据的力学参数识别中的可行性。

paragraphs.en: Keywords: 3D Gaussian splatting, smoothed particle hydrodynamics, inverse analysis
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：3D高斯泼绘、光滑粒子流体动力学、逆分析

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in generative world models for physical artificial intelligence are extending visual scene generation toward interactive simulation for robot learning and action evaluation [ 1 ] . Alongside these developments, reconstructing deformable objects from videos for subsequent physical simulation is bringing vision and mechanics into closer connection [ 2 ] . Translating these capabilities into mechanical analysis requires more than visually plausible motion: the deformation must be governed by constitutive relations and balance laws under specified boundary conditions, with physical parameters that can be inferred from observations [ 3 ] . This requires a physical model of the solid coupled with a rendering model that relates its deformation to the observed appearance. In forward simulation, these models describe the mechanical response and its rendered appearance; in inverse analysis, they enable physical parameters to be estimated by comparing simulated and observed images. A consistent and differentiable connection between vision and solid mechanics is therefore needed to support both deformation simulation and parameter identification from images or videos.
paragraphs.zh: 物理人工智能领域生成式世界模型的最新进展，正在将视觉场景生成扩展至交互式模拟，以支持机器人学习和动作评估 [ 1 ] 。 伴随这些发展，从视频中重建可变形物体并用于后续物理模拟，正使视觉与力学之间的联系日益紧密 [ 2 ] 。 要将这些能力转化为机械分析，仅凭视觉上合理的运动是不够的：其形变必须在特定边界条件下遵循本构关系和平衡定律，并且相关的物理参数需能够从观测结果中推断出来 [ 3 ] 。 这需要一个固体物理模型，并与一个能够将形变与观测外观联系起来的渲染模型相耦合。 在前向模拟中，这些模型描述了机械响应及其渲染后的外观；在逆分析中，它们则可以通过比较模拟图像与观测图像来估计物理参数。 因此，需要在视觉与固体力学之间建立一个一致且可微分的连接，以同时支持形变模拟以及从图像或视频中识别参数。

paragraphs.en: Modern visual reconstruction methods provide the geometric and appearance description required to start from images. In particular, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) represents a scene by anisotropic Gaussian primitives and has become an effective representation for view synthesis [ 4 ] . A 3DGS model, however, is primarily an observation-space representation. Its Gaussian centers, covariances, colors, and opacities are optimized for rendering, and do not by themselves define a constitutive model, material volume, or boundary condition for solid-mechanics analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 现代视觉重建方法提供了从图像出发所需的几何和外观描述。 特别是，3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）通过各向异性高斯基元来表示场景，并已成为视图合成的有效表示方法 [4]。 然而，3DGS模型主要是一种观测空间表示。 其高斯中心、协方差、颜色和透明度是为渲染而优化的，本身并不定义固体力学分析中的构成模型、材料体积或边界条件。

sents.en: Modern visual reconstruction methods provide the geometric and appearance description required to start from images.
sents.zh: 现代视觉重建方法提供了从图像出发所需的几何和外观描述。

paragraphs.en: Physics-integrated Gaussian models have made important progress in forward deformation simulation of 3DGS representations. PhysGaussian couples co-located Gaussians to the material point method (MPM), while Spring-Gaus uses a spring–mass representation; subsequent methods broadened the constitutive range to learned or mixed material responses [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . These formulations provide a direct kinematic link between simulation and rendering and can produce plausible deformation under prescribed material and loading settings. For solid mechanics, however, co-locating mechanical supports with visual primitives would result in a high-dimensional physical discretization, with the mechanical supports tending to be distributed non-uniformly and densely over the object surface.
paragraphs.zh: 物理集成的高斯模型在 3DGS 表示的前向变形模拟方面取得了重要进展。 PhysGaussian 将共位置的高斯函数与材料点法（MPM）相结合，而 Spring-Gaus 则使用弹簧-质量表示；后续方法将本构范围扩展到了学习或混合的材料响应 [5, 6, 7, 8, 9]。 这些公式在模拟与渲染之间建立了直接的运动学联系，并能在预设的材料和加载设置下生成合理的变形。 然而，对于固体力学而言，将机械支撑与视觉原始体共位置会导致高维的物理离散化，且机械支撑往往以非均匀、密集的方式分布在物体表面。

paragraphs.en: Several recent methods therefore use reduced or proxy physical representations to improve the efficiency of forward deformation. Sparse controls can drive dense Gaussians without a constitutive model [ 10 ] ; PhysSplat employs adaptively sampled MPM driving particles, with material property distributions supplied by multimodal language model priors; PHYSPLAT derives appearance agnostic simulation proxies from reconstructed Gaussian scenes; and GASP groups or selects Gaussians for an external physics engine [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . Most closely, PhysTalk fixes rest pose particle neighborhoods and blends particle displacements and deformation gradients back to the original Gaussians [ 14 ] . These studies show that reduced physical representations are promising for efficient forward animation. Nevertheless, the physical representation in the aforementioned methods often serves as a proxy or control model for rendered motion. Without adequate constitutive and boundary modeling, visual agreement alone cannot establish mechanical accuracy under different loading conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，近期的一些方法采用了简化或代理的物理表示形式，以提高正向形变的效率。 稀疏控制可以在没有本构模型的情况下驱动密集的高斯分布 [ 10 ]；PhysSplat 采用自适应采样的 MPM 驱动粒子，其材料属性分布由多模态语言模型先验提供；PHYSPLAT 从重建的高斯场景中推导出与外观无关的模拟代理；而 GASP 则将高斯分布分组或选择以用于外部物理引擎 [ 11 , 12 , 13 ]。 其中最接近的方法 PhysTalk 会固定静止姿态下的粒子邻域，并将粒子位移和形变梯度混合回原始的高斯分布 [ 14 ]。 这些研究表明，简化的物理表示形式在实现高效的正向动画方面具有前景。 然而，上述方法中的物理表示通常仅作为渲染运动的代理或控制模型。 如果没有充分的本构和边界建模，仅凭视觉一致性无法在不同加载条件下确保力学准确性。

paragraphs.en: Beyond computational efficiency and physical fidelity in forward simulation, a further objective is to identify the constitutive parameters and boundary conditions responsible for the observed deformation. Full-field methods such as finite-element model updating and the virtual fields method have established the value of spatially resolved observations for constitutive identification [ 15 ] . Related elasticity inverse problem studies have shown that material parameters and boundary conditions can be jointly identified from partial or local observations when the forward mechanics model and observation operator are properly formulated [ 16 , 17 ] . These methods commonly use displacement or strain fields extracted before the inverse solve. In rendered inverse physics, PAC-NeRF couples neural rendering with differentiable MPM for system identification from multiview videos; PhysDreamer and NeuMA use image-space supervision to infer material behavior; and TopoGaussian, PhysTwin, and MonoPhysics estimate topology, physical digital-twin parameters, or joint geometry–appearance–physics states from visual observations [ 18 , 19 , 7 , 20 , 2 , 21 ] . These works confirm the relevance of rendered identification. However, examples such as TopoGaussian mainly emphasize internal topology or material related recovery, whereas boundary condition identification and its coupling with constitutive parameters remain less developed in mechanics-oriented Gaussian deformation models.
paragraphs.zh: 除了正向模拟中的计算效率和物理保真度之外，另一个目标是确定导致所观察形变的本构参数和边界条件。 全场方法，例如有限元模型更新法和虚拟场法，已经证明了空间分辨观测数据对于本构参数识别的重要性 [ 15 ] 。 相关的弹性力学反问题研究表明，当正向力学模型和观测算子得到恰当构建时，可以通过部分或局部观测同时识别材料参数和边界条件 [ 16 , 17 ] 。 这些方法通常在反演求解之前提取位移或应变场。 在渲染式反物理中，PAC-NeRF 将神经渲染与可微分 MPM 结合，用于从多视角视频中识别系统；PhysDreamer 和 NeuMA 使用图像空间监督来推断材料行为；而 TopoGaussian、PhysTwin 和 MonoPhysics 则通过视觉观测估计拓扑结构、物理数字孪生参数或几何-外观-物理状态的联合状态 [ 18 , 19 , 7 , 20 , 2 , 21 ] 。 这些工作证实了渲染式识别的相关性。 然而，像 TopoGaussian 这样的例子主要强调内部拓扑或材料相关信息的恢复，而边界条件的识别及其与本构参数的耦合，在面向力学的 Gaussian 形变模型中仍发展不足。

sents.zh: 全场方法，例如有限元模型更新法和虚拟场法，已经证明了空间分辨观测数据对于本构参数识别的重要性 [ 15 ] 。

sents.en: Related elasticity inverse problem studies have shown that material parameters and boundary conditions can be jointly identified from partial or local observations when the forward mechanics model and observation operator are properly formulated [ 16 , 17 ] .
sents.zh: 相关的弹性力学反问题研究表明，当正向力学模型和观测算子得到恰当构建时，可以通过部分或局部观测同时识别材料参数和边界条件 [ 16 , 17 ] 。

sents.en: These methods commonly use displacement or strain fields extracted before the inverse solve.
sents.zh: 这些方法通常在反演求解之前提取位移或应变场。

sents.en: In rendered inverse physics, PAC-NeRF couples neural rendering with differentiable MPM for system identification from multiview videos; PhysDreamer and NeuMA use image-space supervision to infer material behavior; and TopoGaussian, PhysTwin, and MonoPhysics estimate topology, physical digital-twin parameters, or joint geometry–appearance–physics states from visual observations [ 18 , 19 , 7 , 20 , 2 , 21 ] .
sents.zh: 在渲染式反物理中，PAC-NeRF 将神经渲染与可微分 MPM 结合，用于从多视角视频中识别系统；PhysDreamer 和 NeuMA 使用图像空间监督来推断材料行为；而 TopoGaussian、PhysTwin 和 MonoPhysics 则通过视觉观测估计拓扑结构、物理数字孪生参数或几何-外观-物理状态的联合状态 [ 18 , 19 , 7 , 20 , 2 , 21 ] 。

sents.en: These works confirm the relevance of rendered identification.
sents.zh: 这些工作证实了渲染式识别的相关性。

sents.en: However, examples such as TopoGaussian mainly emphasize internal topology or material related recovery, whereas boundary condition identification and its coupling with constitutive parameters remain less developed in mechanics-oriented Gaussian deformation models.
sents.zh: 然而，像 TopoGaussian 这样的例子主要强调内部拓扑或材料相关信息的恢复，而边界条件的识别及其与本构参数的耦合，在面向力学的 Gaussian 形变模型中仍发展不足。

paragraphs.en: For a differentiable model supporting both forward simulation and inverse analysis, the solid discretization and the evaluation of parameter sensitivities must be considered together. Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) provides a suitable physical discretization for this purpose because it is mesh-free and naturally Lagrangian compared to the MPM [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] . Corrected and corotated SPH formulations further improve the consistency and stability of elastic solid simulation [ 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] . Extending these solid discretization formulations to gradient-based inverse analysis further requires sensitivities of the simulated response to the unknown physical parameters. Differentiable numerical frameworks provide this capability: JAX-FEM supports sensitivity analysis and inverse design in solid mechanics [ 29 ] , while JAX-SPH enables differentiation through SPH fluid simulations for inverse analysis [ 30 ] . However, differentiable SPH formulations for solid mechanics remain less explored, particularly for the joint identification of constitutive parameters and boundary conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 对于同时支持正向模拟和逆向分析的可微分模型，必须将固体离散化和参数敏感性的评估结合起来考虑。 光滑粒子流体动力学（SPH）为此目的提供了一种合适的物理离散化方法，因为它与 MPM [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] 相比是无网格的且天然具有拉格朗日特性。 经过修正和共旋转的 SPH 公式进一步提升了弹性固体模拟的一致性和稳定性 [ 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] 。 将这些固体离散化公式扩展到基于梯度的逆向分析，还需要获得模拟响应相对于未知物理参数的敏感性。 可微分数值框架提供了这种能力：JAX-FEM 支持固体力学中的敏感性分析和逆向设计 [ 29 ] ，而 JAX-SPH 则实现了通过 SPH 流体模拟进行逆向分析的微分操作 [ 30 ] 。 然而，用于固体力学的可微分 SPH 公式仍较少被研究，尤其是在本构参数和边界条件的联合识别方面。

paragraphs.en: Despite these advances, constructing mechanical models from visual observations remains challenging when efficient forward simulation must preserve physical and rendering fidelity with fewer mechanical degrees of freedom. Extending the same model to inverse analysis poses the additional challenge of identifying constitutive parameters and boundary conditions from images within a unified differentiable formulation. To address these challenges, this work develops a Lagrangian-coupled 3D Gaussian Splatting–SPH model for forward simulation and inverse analysis in solid mechanics. In the proposed model, the observed object is first represented by a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model reconstructed from multi-view images or video frames. An envelope-based procedure is then used to generate an SPH particle support from the reconstructed Gaussian geometry, while the solid-mechanics response is computed on the SPH model rather than directly on the Gaussian primitives. The deformation of the SPH model is transferred back to the Gaussian representation through a reference-configuration Lagrangian mapping, which reconstructs Gaussian centers and covariance deformation from neighboring SPH particle displacement and local deformation. The coupled simulation, transfer, and rendering process is implemented in JAX, allowing the same model to be used for both forward deformation rendering and gradient-based inverse analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，但在需要高效正向模拟且必须以更少的机械自由度保持物理和渲染保真度的情况下，从视觉观察中构建机械模型仍然具有挑战性。 将同一模型扩展到逆分析则带来了额外的挑战：如何在统一的可微分框架内从图像中识别本构参数和边界条件。 为应对这些挑战，本研究开发了一种拉格朗日耦合的三维高斯泼溅–SPH模型，用于固体力学中的正向模拟和逆分析。 在提出的模型中，首先通过从多视角图像或视频帧重建的三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）模型来表示所观察到的物体。 随后使用基于包络的方法，从重建的高斯几何结构中生成SPH粒子支撑，而固体力学响应则是在SPH模型上计算，而非直接在高斯原语上计算。 SPH模型的形变通过参考构型拉格朗日映射反向传递到高斯表示中，该映射根据邻近SPH粒子的位移和局部形变重建高斯中心和协方差形变。 这种耦合的模拟、传递和渲染过程在JAX中实现，使得同一模型既可用于正向形变渲染，也可用于基于梯度的逆分析。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this work are reflected in three aspects. First, a differentiable Lagrangian SPH-GS transfer is proposed to bridge the 3DGS rendering model and the SPH physical model. This enables a lower-dimensional mechanical discretization to drive a dense Gaussian representation, improving simulation efficiency while retaining physical and rendering fidelity. Second, the corrected corotated SPH model is extended to incorporate hyperelastic and Kelvin–Voigt viscoelastic responses together with Robin-like boundary conditions, expanding the physical modeling capabilities of the coupled model beyond elastic deformation under fixed or free constraints. Third, forward simulation and inverse analysis are connected within the same differentiable 3DGS-SPH model, enabling joint identification of constitutive parameters and boundary conditions from image or video observations. The JAX implementation provides parameter gradients through simulation, Lagrangian transfer, and rendering to support gradient-based optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作的主要贡献体现在三个方面。 首先，提出了一种可微分的拉格朗日 SPH-GS 传输方法，以连接 3DGS 渲染模型与 SPH 物理模型。 这使得低维度的力学离散化能够驱动密集的高斯表示，从而在保持物理和渲染保真度的同时提升模拟效率。 其次，修正后的共旋转 SPH 模型被扩展，以同时包含超弹性和凯尔文-沃伊特黏弹性响应以及罗宾类边界条件，使耦合模型的物理建模能力超越了固定或自由约束下的弹性变形。 第三，前向模拟与逆分析被整合到同一个可微分的 3DGS-SPH 模型中，从而能够从图像或视频观测中联合识别本构参数和边界条件。 JAX 实现通过模拟、拉格朗日传输和渲染提供参数梯度，以支持基于梯度的优化。

paragraphs.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 presents the mathematical formulation of the forward simulation and inverse analysis problems. Section 3 introduces the proposed 3DGS-SPH model, including the 3D Gaussian representation, envelope-based SPH support generation, corrected solid SPH formulation, Lagrangian SPH-GS transfer, and inverse analysis formulation. Section 4 reports numerical experiments for SPH validation, mapping assessment, forward simulation, sensitivity verification, and inverse parameter identification. Section 5 discusses the numerical results, and Section 6 concludes the paper with potential directions for future work.

paragraphs.en: To address the forward simulation and inverse analysis problems formulated in Section 2 , this work proposes a Lagrangian-coupled 3DGS-SPH model, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (d). The proposed model connects a 3DGS rendering model with a separately discretized SPH physical model through a differentiable Lagrangian SPH-GS transfer.

paragraphs.en: The methodological details are introduced in the following four subsections. Section 3.1 describes the 3DGS representation, rendering operation, and envelope-based construction of the SPH support. Section 3.2 summarizes the corrected solid-SPH model, constitutive responses, boundary conditions, and matrix-free solution. Section 3.3 derives the proposed Lagrangian SPH-GS transfer, which couples a dense Gaussian representation to an independently discretized physical model. Finally, Section 3.4 formulates parameter identification through the resulting coupled model.
paragraphs.zh: 方法细节将在以下四个小节中介绍。 第 3.1 节描述了 3DGS 表示、渲染操作以及基于包络的 SPH 支撑构建。 第 3.2 节总结了修正后的实体-SPH 模型、本构响应、边界条件和无矩阵求解方法。 第 3.3 节推导了所提出的拉格朗日 SPH-GS 传递方法，该方法将密集的高斯表示与独立离散化的物理模型耦合。 最后，第 3.4 节通过由此产生的耦合模型建立了参数识别公式。

paragraphs.en: Although the Gaussian representation describes the visible surface, solid mechanics requires a volumetric reference domain. An envelope-filling procedure is therefore used to construct the SPH support from the reconstructed 3DGS model. The insertion of interior supports follows the grid-based volumetric filling rule used in PhysGaussian and TopoGaussian [ 5 , 20 ] . In contrast, the surface supports are not sampled from the original Gaussian primitives; both surface and interior supports are defined by occupied grid-cell centers, as illustrated in Fig. 2 .

paragraphs.en: Compared with co-located coupling, where Gaussian-derived samples are tied to mechanical particles, the proposed transfer permits many Gaussians to share a smaller set of SPH supports while retaining distinct weights and locally reconstructed deformation gradients. It therefore decouples rendering resolution from the dimension and surface concentration of the mechanical system while providing the sensitivity propagation required for inverse analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 与共定位耦合方式不同——在共定位耦合中，高斯派生样本与机械粒子是绑定的——所提出的传输方法允许多个高斯函数共享一组较小的 SPH 支撑点，同时保留各自独立的权重和局部重建的变形梯度。 因此，这种方法将渲染分辨率与机械系统的维度和表面浓度解耦，同时提供了逆分析所需的敏感度传播能力。

paragraphs.en: The experiments are designed to evaluate the proposed 3DGS-SPH model for forward simulation and inverse analysis. Section 4.1 examines deformation under different constitutive models, boundary conditions, and object geometries, and Section 4.2 evaluates the identification of material and boundary parameters from deformation observations. Numerical verification of the individual model components is presented in Appendix. B . These tests demonstrate the accuracy of the SPH displacement response, the computational efficiency and rendering agreement achieved with the Lagrangian SPH-GS transfer, and the agreement of AD sensitivities with finite-difference estimates.
paragraphs.zh: 这些实验旨在评估所提出的 3DGS-SPH 模型在正向模拟和逆分析方面的性能。 第 4.1 节研究了不同本构模型、边界条件和物体几何形状下的变形，而第 4.2 节则评估了基于变形观测对材料和边界参数进行识别的能力。 各模型组件的数值验证结果见附录 B。 这些测试证明了 SPH 位移响应的准确性、拉格朗日 SPH-GS 传递方法所达到的计算效率和渲染一致性，以及 AD 敏感度与有限差分估计值之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: The forward experiments evaluate the proposed 3DGS-SPH model on a beam, a bridge, and a liver-shaped object. The regular beam, whose surface carries digital image correlation (DIC)-style speckle texture and word “HKUST”, provides a controlled benchmark in which the influence of material and boundary settings can be examined directly. The bridge and liver-shaped cases then test the performance of the proposed model for geometrically distinct reconstructions which are close to real-world applications. The design of the forward experiments is summarized in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 正向实验在梁、桥梁和肝脏形状物体上评估了所提出的 3DGS-SPH 模型。 常规梁的表面带有数字图像相关（DIC）风格的斑点纹理和“HKUST”字样，它提供了一个受控的基准，可以直接检验材料和边界设置的影响。 桥梁和肝脏形状的案例则测试了该模型在几何结构差异显著且接近实际应用的重建任务中的性能。 正向实验的设计总结于表 1。

sents.en: The forward experiments evaluate the proposed 3DGS-SPH model on a beam, a bridge, and a liver-shaped object.
sents.zh: 正向实验在梁、桥梁和肝脏形状物体上评估了所提出的 3DGS-SPH 模型。

sents.en: The regular beam, whose surface carries digital image correlation (DIC)-style speckle texture and word “HKUST”, provides a controlled benchmark in which the influence of material and boundary settings can be examined directly.
sents.zh: 常规梁的表面带有数字图像相关（DIC）风格的斑点纹理和“HKUST”字样，它提供了一个受控的基准，可以直接检验材料和边界设置的影响。

sents.en: The bridge and liver-shaped cases then test the performance of the proposed model for geometrically distinct reconstructions which are close to real-world applications.
sents.zh: 桥梁和肝脏形状的案例则测试了该模型在几何结构差异显著且接近实际应用的重建任务中的性能。

sents.en: The design of the forward experiments is summarized in Table 1 .
sents.zh: 正向实验的设计总结于表 1。

paragraphs.en: For the beam benchmark, the 10,000 kernel 3DGS model is reconstructed from multiview images of the undeformed beam. Figure 6 compares reference images in the reference data 𝔇 r \mathfrak{D}_{r} with the corresponding renderings generated by the reconstructed 3DGS model. The 1225-particle SPH model is generated from the reconstructed geometry using the procedure in Section 3.1.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于梁基准测试，10,000 核的 3DGS 模型是根据未变形梁的多视角图像重建的。 图 6 将参考数据 𝔇 r \mathfrak{D}_{r} 中的参考图像与由重建的 3DGS 模型生成的对应渲染图像进行了比较。 1225 粒子的 SPH 模型是根据重建的几何形状，使用第 3.1.2 节中的流程生成的。

sents.en: For the beam benchmark, the 10,000 kernel 3DGS model is reconstructed from multiview images of the undeformed beam.
sents.zh: 对于梁基准测试，10,000 核的 3DGS 模型是根据未变形梁的多视角图像重建的。

sents.en: Figure 6 compares reference images in the reference data 𝔇 r \mathfrak{D}_{r} with the corresponding renderings generated by the reconstructed 3DGS model.
sents.zh: 图 6 将参考数据 𝔇 r \mathfrak{D}_{r} 中的参考图像与由重建的 3DGS 模型生成的对应渲染图像进行了比较。

sents.en: The 1225-particle SPH model is generated from the reconstructed geometry using the procedure in Section 3.1.2 .
sents.zh: 1225 粒子的 SPH 模型是根据重建的几何形状，使用第 3.1.2 节中的流程生成的。

paragraphs.en: All beam cases use E = 10 4 ​ Pa E=10^{4}\,\mathrm{Pa} , ν = 0.35 \nu=0.35 , ρ 0 = 1200 ​ kg ⋅ m − 3 \rho_{0}=1200\,\mathrm{kg}\cdot\mathrm{m^{-3}} , a total downward load magnitude of 20 ​ N 20\,\mathrm{N} on the right end. The left end and the lower surface over the first 20 % 20\% of the beam length are fixed; the designated remaining lower region has Robin support, and the other unloaded surfaces are free (Fig. 7 (a)). The simulations use 1000 steps with Δ ​ t = 0.02 ​ s \Delta t=0.02\,\mathrm{s} ; numerical velocity damping is set to γ num = 2 × 10 − 2 \gamma_{\mathrm{num}}=2\times 10^{-2} for quasi-static simulation and disabled for the dynamic cases.

paragraphs.en: The quasi-static cases examine the influence of the Robin stiffness field: weak support with k R = 10 − 2 ​ s − 2 k_{R}=10^{-2}\,\mathrm{s^{-2}} , a near-fixed limit k R = 10 4 ​ s − 2 k_{R}=10^{4}\,\mathrm{s^{-2}} , and a heterogeneous field k R = ( 10 4 , 10 2 ) ​ s − 2 k_{R}=(10^{4},10^{2})\,\mathrm{s^{-2}} over two axial subregions of the same Robin region, separated at its midpoint. Figure 7 compares the rendering image of final deformation and corresponding SPH deformations for the corotated linear elastic model. Weak restraint permits substantial bending, whereas strong restraint suppresses motion in the Robin region; heterogeneous stiffness produces spatially selective restraint. Table 2 reports the mean downward displacements of the loaded and Robin regions, denoted by w load w_{\mathrm{load}} and w R w_{R} , respectively, and shows that the neo-Hookean model yields similar responses under the tested conditions.

paragraphs.en: The dynamic cases retain weak Robin support boundary condition settings and examine Kelvin–Voigt viscosity with η s = η b ∈ { 1000 , 5000 , 10000 } ​ Pa ⋅ s \eta_{s}=\eta_{b}\in\{1000,5000,10000\}\,\mathrm{Pa}\cdot\mathrm{s} , alongside an elastic reference with η s = η b = 0 \eta_{s}=\eta_{b}=0 . Figure 8 (a) shows that increasing viscosity reduces the oscillation amplitude: the peak loaded-end displacement decreases from 1.0369 ​ m 1.0369\,\mathrm{m} in the elastic reference to 0.6173 ​ m 0.6173\,\mathrm{m} at the largest tested viscosity. The corotated-linear and neo-Hookean responses remain close at η s = η b = 5000 ​ Pa ⋅ s \eta_{s}=\eta_{b}=5000\,\mathrm{Pa}\cdot\mathrm{s} (Fig. 8 (b,c)). Table 3 summarizes the final and peak displacements and SPH simulation times. The Kelvin–Voigt cases require more computation than the elastic reference, with runtime increasing with viscosity over the tested range.
paragraphs.zh: 动态案例保留了弱罗宾支撑边界条件设置，并考察了当 η s = η b ∈ { 1000 , 5000 , 10000 } ​ Pa ⋅ s \eta_{s}=\eta_{b}\in\{1000,5000,10000\}\,\mathrm{Pa}\cdot\mathrm{s} 时的凯尔文-沃伊特黏性，同时对比了 η s = η b = 0 \eta_{s}=\eta_{b}=0 的弹性参考情况。 图 8 (a) 显示，黏性增大会降低振荡振幅：在弹性参考情况下，受载端点的最大位移为 1.0369 ​ m 1.0369\,\mathrm{m}，而在测试的最大黏性条件下则降至 0.6173 ​ m 0.6173\,\mathrm{m}。 当 η s = η b = 5000 ​ Pa ⋅ s \eta_{s}=\eta_{b}=5000\,\mathrm{Pa}\cdot\mathrm{s} 时，共转线性模型与新胡克模型的响应结果仍较为接近（图 8 (b,c)）。 表 3 总结了最终位移、最大位移以及 SPH 模拟所需时间。 凯尔文-沃伊特案例所需的计算量大于弹性参考案例，并且在所测试的黏性范围内，运行时间随黏性的增加而增长。

paragraphs.en: The bridge and liver-shaped cases extend the forward simulations to irregular geometries reconstructed from reference images in 𝔇 r \mathfrak{D}_{\mathrm{r}} (Fig. 9 ). Both use corotated-linear elasticity, with Kelvin–Voigt viscosity added for the liver-shaped case. Their material parameters and load magnitudes are listed in Table 4 . The simulations use 1000 steps with Δ ​ t = 0.02 ​ s \Delta t=0.02\,\mathrm{s} , with numerical velocity damping γ num = 0.02 \gamma_{\mathrm{num}}=0.02 for the quasi-static bridge and zero for the dynamic liver-shaped object. Their boundary conditions are shown in Fig. 10 . The bridge is fixed over the lowest 20% of its height and loaded downward on the uppermost particle layer within a central square of side length equal to half its width. In contrast, the liver-shaped object uses surface supports, fixed over the lowest 15% of its height and restrained by k R = 100 ​ s − 2 k_{R}=100\,\mathrm{s^{-2}} in the adjacent 15–30% band. Its downward load acts within the final 10% of its extent along the positive x x -direction, excluding the fixed and Robin regions.
paragraphs.zh: 桥梁和肝脏形状的模型将正向模拟扩展到了从参考图像中重建的不规则几何形状（属于 𝔇 r \mathfrak{D}_{\mathrm{r}}，见第 9 图）。 两者均使用共旋转线性弹性理论，其中肝脏形状模型还额外加入了凯尔文-沃伊特黏性。 它们的材料参数和载荷大小列于表 4 中。 模拟使用了 1000 个时间步长，Δ t = 0.02 ​ s \Delta t=0.02\,\mathrm{s}；对于准静态桥梁模型，数值速度阻尼 γ num = 0.02 \gamma_{\mathrm{num}}=0.02，而对于动态的肝脏形状物体，该阻尼为零。 它们的边界条件如第 10 图所示。 桥梁模型在其高度最低的 20% 区域被固定，并在其宽度一半长度的中心正方形区域内，对最上层的粒子施加向下的载荷。 相比之下，肝脏形状物体使用了表面支撑：其高度最低的 15% 区域被固定，而在相邻的 15–30% 高度带内则通过 k R = 100 ​ s − 2 k_{R}=100\,\mathrm{s^{-2}} 进行约束。 其向下的载荷作用于沿正 x x 方向延伸范围的最后 10% 区域内，且不包括固定区域和罗宾边界区域。

paragraphs.en: Under these conditions, the bridge approaches a stationary deflected configuration, whereas the liver-shaped object exhibits a damped transient response in the loaded and Robin regions. Figure 11 presents these responses through the initial and deformed Gaussian renderings and displacement histories. Table 5 summarizes the final and peak loaded-region displacements and SPH simulation times alongside the model sizes. Together with the beam results, these cases demonstrate quasi-static and dynamic forward simulation using the 3DGS-SPH model across distinct geometries, constitutive models, and boundary conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些条件下，桥梁接近于一个静止的挠度构型，而肝脏状物体则在受载区域和罗宾区域内表现出阻尼瞬态响应。 图 11 通过初始和高斯变形渲染以及位移历史展示了这些响应。 表 5 总结了最终和峰值受载区域的位移、SPH 模拟时间以及模型尺寸。 结合梁的结果，这些案例展示了使用 3DGS-SPH 模型在不同几何形状、本构模型和边界条件下进行的准静态和动态正向模拟。

paragraphs.en: The inverse analysis experiments evaluate material and boundary parameter identification from images of deformation observations using the proposed 3DGS-SPH model. The beam provides the principal benchmark, while the bridge and liver-shaped examples examine selected inverse capabilities on distinct geometries. All cases minimize the image-mismatch objective in Eq. ( 24 ) using bound-constrained L-BFGS-B and AD gradients, with case-specific regularization described below. Gradient verification is reported in B.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 反向分析实验利用所提出的 3DGS-SPH 模型，通过变形观测图像来评估材料参数和边界参数的识别能力。 梁结构提供了主要基准，而桥梁和肝脏形状的示例则用于检验在几何形态各异的情况下选择性的反向分析能力。 所有案例均最小化方程中的图像不匹配目标函数。 ( 24 ) 该过程采用有界约束的 L-BFGS-B 算法和 AD 梯度，具体案例相关的正则化方法如下所述。 梯度验证结果见 B.3 节。

paragraphs.en: The experiment design is summarized in Table 6 . The cases progress from separate material and boundary identification to joint recovery and hierarchical static-dynamic identification. All inverse simulations use 1000 steps with Δ ​ t = 0.02 ​ s \Delta t=0.02\,\mathrm{s} . Quasi-static cases use numerical velocity damping γ num = 2 × 10 − 2 \gamma_{\mathrm{num}}=2\times 10^{-2} and terminal observations; dynamic cases disable numerical damping and use five transient images selected from states saved every 100 steps.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设计总结于表 6。 这些案例从单独的材料和边界识别，逐步发展为联合恢复以及分层静态-动态识别。 所有逆模拟均使用 1000 个步骤，其中 Δ t = 0.02 s \Delta t=0.02\,\mathrm{s}。 准静态案例使用数值速度阻尼 γ num = 2 × 10 − 2 \gamma_{\mathrm{num}}=2\times 10^{-2} 和终端观测；动态案例则禁用数值阻尼，并使用从每 100 步保存的状态中选取的五张瞬态图像。

paragraphs.en: Robustness to observation noise is examined using the corotated-linear beam and eight-control RBF field. Each reference-image pixel is independently replaced by black or white with a total probability of 1%, with equal probabilities for the two values. This realization remains fixed during optimization; noise is not added to the simulated images. The initial parameters remain E 0 = 5000 ​ Pa E_{0}=5000\,\mathrm{Pa} and k R , 0 = 10 3 ​ s − 2 k_{R,0}=10^{3}\,\mathrm{s^{-2}} , with prior stiffness 1 ​ s − 2 1\,\mathrm{s^{-2}} and λ R = 10 − 8 \lambda_{R}=10^{-8} . Figure 16 shows recovery of the modulus within 3.59 % 3.59\% of E ⋆ = 10 4 ​ Pa E^{\star}=10^{4}\,\mathrm{Pa} , while the observation MSE approaches the noise floor. Evaluated against the clean reference, image MSE decreases from 9.98 × 10 − 4 9.98\times 10^{-4} to 3.43 × 10 − 6 3.43\times 10^{-6} , and global displacement RMSE decreases from 8.45 × 10 − 3 ​ m 8.45\times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{m} to 5.49 × 10 − 4 ​ m 5.49\times 10^{-4}\,\mathrm{m} . The test therefore demonstrates effective material and boundary response recovery despite the imposed image noise.

paragraphs.en: These results show that the boundary representation influences material identification as well as boundary recovery. Under both constitutive models, the RBF representation yields smaller Youngs modulus errors while reproducing the displacement over the Robin region. This suggests that a compact boundary parameterization helps constrain the joint estimation of material stiffness and boundary restraint from the observed deformation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，边界表示不仅影响材料识别，也影响边界恢复。 在两种本构模型下，RBF 表示都能更精确地再现罗宾区域的位移，同时使杨氏模量的误差更小。 这表明，紧凑的边界参数化有助于根据观测到的形变，对材料刚度和边界约束的联合估计施加约束。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the inverse experiments demonstrate that the proposed 3DGS-SPH model can be applied seamlessly to inverse analysis of physical parameter estimation from images of deformation observations. Across the beam, bridge, and liver-shaped cases, the model recovers material parameters, Robin-region displacement responses, and selected viscoelastic parameters within a unified differentiable inverse-analysis framework. The salt-and-pepper noise case further shows that effective material and boundar -response recovery can be maintained when the observed image contains a representative impulse-noise perturbation.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，反向实验表明，所提出的 3DGS-SPH 模型可以无缝应用于基于变形观测图像的物理参数估计的反向分析。 在梁、桥梁和肝脏形状的案例中，该模型在一个统一的可微反向分析框架内恢复了材料参数、罗宾区域的位移响应以及选定的黏弹性参数。 椒盐噪声案例进一步表明，当观测图像包含具有代表性的脉冲噪声扰动时，仍能保持对材料和边界响应的有效恢复。

sents.en: Overall, the inverse experiments demonstrate that the proposed 3DGS-SPH model can be applied seamlessly to inverse analysis of physical parameter estimation from images of deformation observations.
sents.zh: 总体而言，反向实验表明，所提出的 3DGS-SPH 模型可以无缝应用于基于变形观测图像的物理参数估计的反向分析。

sents.en: Across the beam, bridge, and liver-shaped cases, the model recovers material parameters, Robin-region displacement responses, and selected viscoelastic parameters within a unified differentiable inverse-analysis framework.
sents.zh: 在梁、桥梁和肝脏形状的案例中，该模型在一个统一的可微反向分析框架内恢复了材料参数、罗宾区域的位移响应以及选定的黏弹性参数。

sents.en: The salt-and-pepper noise case further shows that effective material and boundar -response recovery can be maintained when the observed image contains a representative impulse-noise perturbation.
sents.zh: 椒盐噪声案例进一步表明，当观测图像包含具有代表性的脉冲噪声扰动时，仍能保持对材料和边界响应的有效恢复。

paragraphs.en: The beam comparison demonstrates the computational advantage of the proposed 3DGS–SPH model over the co-located construction. Using Gaussian centers as mechanical particles ties the SPH discretization to the dense, surface-concentrated distribution required for rendering, increasing the mechanical cost without necessarily improving volumetric support quality. The proposed Lagrangian SPH–GS transfer removes this dependence, allowing a coarser volumetric SPH model to drive the same Gaussian rendering model. In the tested beam case, this reduces mechanical simulation time by a factor of 48 while retaining close rendering agreement at matched deformation amplitudes (Appendix B.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该梁体对比展示了所提出的 3DGS–SPH 模型相较于共定位结构在计算效率上的优势。 将高斯中心用作力学粒子，会将 SPH 离散化与渲染所需的密集且集中于表面的分布绑定在一起，从而增加力学计算成本，却未必能提升体积支撑质量。 所提出的拉格朗日 SPH–GS 传输方法消除了这种依赖关系，使得更粗略的体积 SPH 模型也能驱动相同的高斯渲染模型。 在测试的梁体案例中，这种方法将力学模拟时间减少了 48 倍，同时在匹配变形振幅下仍保持了高度一致的渲染效果（附录 B.2）。

Although this produces a larger AD–FD discrepancy than in the other tested parameters, accurate modulus recovery in the prescribed-boundary beam case indicates that the resulting gradients remain effective for that identification task.

paragraphs.en: The boundary results distinguish recovery of an effective displacement response from identification of the local stiffness field. As Robin restraint approaches free or fixed behavior, deformation becomes less informative about stiffness magnitude, allowing irregular particlewise estimates to reproduce the observed response. The RBF representation restricts the field to a smoother, lower-dimensional space and improves recovery when the support variation is compatible with that representation. Its smaller modulus errors in both joint-identification cases further indicate that boundary parameterization affects material estimation as well as support recovery. Parameterization and regularization therefore help constrain the admissible solutions, rather than merely reduce image mismatch.
paragraphs.zh: 边界结果将有效位移响应的恢复与局部刚度场的识别区分开来。 随着 Robin 约束趋近于自由或固定行为，形变对刚度大小的指示性减弱，使得不规则的逐颗粒估计能够再现观测到的响应。 RBF 表示法将场限制在更平滑、维度更低的空间中，并在支撑变化与该表示法兼容时提高了恢复效果。 在两种关节识别情况下，其模量误差更小，进一步表明边界参数化不仅影响支撑恢复，也影响材料估计。 因此，参数化和正则化有助于约束可接受解，而不仅仅是减少图像不匹配。

More accurate recovery of η s \eta_{s} than η b \eta_{b} in the prescribed-boundary beam test suggests that the bending observations constrain shear viscosity more strongly than bulk viscosity. In the hierarchical analysis, residual errors in the identified modulus and boundary field can also influence subsequent viscosity estimates. These results motivate richer transient excitation and observation sequences to better distinguish elastic, boundary, and viscous effects within the same coupled model.
paragraphs.zh: 动态案例同样凸显了观测敏感性的作用。 在预设边界梁测试中，η s \eta_{s} 的恢复比 η b \eta_{b} 更准确，这表明弯曲观测对剪切粘度的约束强于对体粘度的约束。 在分层分析中，已识别模量和边界场中的残余误差也可能影响后续的粘度估计。 这些结果促使我们采用更丰富的瞬态激励和观测序列，以便在同一耦合模型内更好地区分弹性、边界和粘性效应。

paragraphs.en: This work developed a differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3DGS-SPH model for forward simulation and inverse analysis of deformable solids reconstructed from image or video observations. The central idea is to construct a mechanics-oriented SPH model from the reconstructed Gaussian envelope and to couple this physical model to the Gaussian representation through a reference-configuration Lagrangian transfer. In this way, a lower-dimensional SPH model can provide a mechanically reasonable discretization for constitutive response, boundary conditions, and time integration, while the higher-resolution Gaussian model retains its role as the surface geometry and appearance representation for rendering. The JAX implementation further preserves the differentiable structure of the coupled simulation, transfer, and rendering process, enabling automatic-differentiation gradients for the inverse analysis pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作开发了一种可微分的拉格朗日耦合 3DGS-SPH 模型，用于对通过图像或视频观测重建的可变形固体进行正向模拟和逆分析。 其核心思想是从重建的高斯包络中构建一个以力学为导向的 SPH 模型，并通过参考构型下的拉格朗日转移将该物理模型与高斯表示耦合起来。 通过这种方式，低维度的 SPH 模型可以为本构响应、边界条件和时间积分提供力学上合理的离散化，而高分辨率的高斯模型则保留其作为渲染表面几何和外观表示的功能。 JAX 实现进一步保留了耦合模拟、转移和渲染过程的可微分结构，从而为逆分析流程提供了自动求导梯度。

paragraphs.en: The numerical studies demonstrate the main capabilities of the proposed model. The corrected solid-SPH response was compared with finite-element reference results, and the Lagrangian SPH-GS transfer was shown to produce rendered deformation close to the co-located construction while using a substantially lower-dimensional physical discretization. Forward examples on beam, bridge, and liver-shaped objects further show that the same coupled model can represent linear elastic, hyperelastic, and Kelvin–Voigt viscoelastic responses under different boundary settings. The sensitivity checks and inverse examples verify that the implemented forward process can be used for gradient-based estimation of constitutive and boundary parameters from deformation images or video frames.
paragraphs.zh: 数值研究展示了所提出模型的主要能力。 修正后的固体-SPH响应与有限元参考结果进行了比较，结果表明，拉格朗日SPH-GS传递方法能够在采用显著更低维度的物理离散化的同时，生成与同位置结构接近的变形渲染效果。 对梁、桥梁和肝脏形状物体的正向示例进一步表明，同一耦合模型能够在不同边界条件下表示线性弹性、超弹性和凯尔文-沃伊特黏弹性响应。 敏感性检查和反向示例验证了所实现的正向过程可用于基于梯度从变形图像或视频帧中估计本构和边界参数。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the results support the proposed 3DGS-SPH model as a practical route for connecting reconstructed object appearance with solid-mechanics simulation and parameter identification. Future work will extend the same modeling framework toward contact and interaction problems, inverse analysis under evolving boundary conditions, geometry-aware SPH-GS transfer, and more complex constitutive and loading scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，研究结果支持所提出的 3DGS-SPH 模型，将其视为连接重构物体外观与固体力学模拟及参数识别的一种实用方法。 未来的工作将把相同的建模框架扩展到接触与相互作用问题、随边界条件演化的逆分析、几何感知的 SPH-GS 传递，以及更复杂的本构和加载场景。

paragraphs.en: Following the two-pass corrected SPH force evaluation of Peer et al. [ 28 ] , each current force and each matrix-vector product are evaluated by the same traversal of the fixed reference neighbor graph. The first pass constructs the deformation-gradient, strain-rate, stress, or stress-increment quantity at every support, depending on the selected constitutive model. The second pass applies the corrected stress-divergence operator to assemble the corresponding force or force increment. Consequently, neo-Hookean elasticity modifies the stress and material tangent while preserving the corrected SPH force assembly, Kelvin–Voigt viscosity contributes a rate-dependent stress through 𝑭 ˙ \dot{\bm{F}} , and the Robin-like condition contributes both a current restoring force and a tangent resistance to the same implicit solve.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Peer 等人 [28] 提出的两遍修正 SPH 力计算方法，每次的当前力和每个矩阵-向量乘积都通过遍历固定的参考邻域图来完成。第一遍根据所选的本构模型，在每个支撑点构建形变梯度、应变率、应力或应力增量。第二遍则将修正后的应力散算子应用于相应的力或力增量的组装过程。因此，新胡克弹性模型会修改应力和材料切线，同时保持修正后的 SPH 力组装不变；开尔文-沃伊特黏性通过 𝑭 ˙ \dot{\bm{F}} 引入一个与速率相关的应力；而类罗宾边界条件则为相同的隐式求解贡献了当前的恢复力和切线阻力。

paragraphs.en: This subsection provides a reference check for the solid SPH discretization. A linear elastic beam is used as a controlled benchmark, and the adopted corrected SPH response is compared with a finite-element reference computed using JAX-FEM [ 29 ] . The comparison examines whether the SPH discretization reproduces the dominant deformation pattern of the reference solution.
paragraphs.zh: 本小节对固体 SPH 离散化方法进行了参考验证。 采用线性弹性梁作为受控基准，并将修正后的 SPH 响应与使用 JAX-FEM [ 29 ] 计算得到的有限元参考结果进行比较。 该比较旨在检验 SPH 离散化方法是否能够复现参考解中的主要变形模式。

paragraphs.en: The final deformed configurations and the section-averaged displacement responses are summarized in Fig. 1 . The adopted corrected SPH model follows the global bending pattern of the FEM reference, whereas the surface-dense and uncorrected variants produce visibly larger deflections. This comparison indicates that both the spatial support distribution and the first-order kernel correction affect the beam response.

paragraphs.en: Overall, this reference comparison supports the corrected SPH discretization used in the remaining experiments. It also indicates that surface-biased support distributions and uncorrected kernel gradients are less suitable as the mechanical basis of the coupled 3DGS-SPH model.

paragraphs.en: This experiment evaluates the agreement between the deformation renderings produced by the proposed Lagrangian-coupled 3DGS-SPH model and the conventional co-located model. paragraphs.en: Two coupled constructions are considered. The conventional co-located model assigns one surface SPH support to every Gaussian center, giving 10,000 surface supports supplemented by 600 interior supports. This direct correspondence between graphical and physical primitives is commonly adopted in physics-integrated Gaussian representations [ 5 , 20 ] . In contrast, the proposed Lagrangian-coupled model constructs the physical discretization independently, using 674 quasi-uniform surface supports and the same 600 interior supports. The resulting 1,274-particle state drives all 10,000 Gaussian kernels through the reference-configuration transfer graph introduced in Sec. 3.3 . These two physical discretizations are compared in Fig. 2 (a) and (b).
paragraphs.zh: 本文考虑了两种耦合结构。 传统的共位置模型为每个高斯中心分配一个表面 SPH 支撑，从而得到 10,000 个表面支撑，并辅以 600 个内部支撑。 图形原语与物理原语之间的这种直接对应关系在集成物理的高斯表示方法中通常被采用 [5, 20]。 相比之下，所提出的拉格朗日耦合模型独立构建物理离散化，使用 674 个准均匀表面支撑以及相同的 600 个内部支撑。 由此产生的 1,274 粒子状态通过第 3.3 节引入的参考构型转移图驱动全部 10,000 个高斯核。 这两种物理离散化在图 2(a) 和 (b) 中进行了比较。

Because the two constructions contain different numbers of surface supports, the redistribution defined in Eq. ( 43 ) is applied to the co-located model while retaining its interior discretization, so that the two models consequently have the same represented mass and rest volume.

paragraphs.en: The co-located construction and the proposed Lagrangian SPH–GS transfer are compared using the same 3DGS rendering model. Their underlying SPH discretizations, however, would produce different displacement amplitudes as mentioned in B.1 (surface-dense SPH model case). To reduce the influence of this difference on the rendering comparison, the Gaussian-center displacements and affine-deformation increments obtained through the Lagrangian transfer are scaled to match the mean loaded-end Gaussian displacement of the co-located construction. The rendered images are then compared at matched deformation amplitudes.
paragraphs.zh: 使用相同的 3DGS 渲染模型，对共定位结构以及所提出的拉格朗日 SPH–GS 传递方法进行比较。 然而，如 B.1（表面密集 SPH 模型案例）中所述，它们各自的 SPH 离散化方法会产生不同的位移振幅。 为减少这种差异对渲染比较的影响，通过拉格朗日传递获得的高斯中心位移和仿射变形增量会被缩放，以匹配共定位结构在加载端处的平均高斯位移。 随后，在匹配的变形振幅下对渲染图像进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The proposed model reduces the physical particle count by 88.0% and the number of SPH neighbor pairs from 3,394,870 to 72,370. On the same hardware, the 1,000-step rollout time decreases from 497.7 ​ s 497.7\,\mathrm{s} to 10.37 ​ s 10.37\,\mathrm{s} , corresponding to a 48.0-fold acceleration. Together with the bounded transfer error and close agreement between the amplitude-adjusted deformation renderings, these results demonstrate that the proposed Lagrangian coupling can substantially reduce the physical simulation cost while retaining the deformation characteristics required for Gaussian rendering.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的模型将物理粒子数量减少了 88.0%，并将 SPH 邻域对的数量从 3,394,870 减少到 72,370。 在同一硬件上，1,000 步的展开时间从 497.7 ​ s 497.7\,\mathrm{s} 缩短至 10.37 ​ s 10.37\,\mathrm{s}，相当于加速了 48.0 倍。 结合有界的传输误差以及经振幅调整的形变渲染结果之间的高度一致，这些结果表明，所提出的拉格朗日耦合方法能够在保留高斯渲染所需的形变特征的同时，显著降低物理模拟成本。

paragraphs.en: This experiment evaluates the accuracy of sensitivities computed by automatic differentiation (AD) using the beam model in Section 4.1 . The evaluated objective is the image-mismatch term 𝒥 o \mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{o}} in Eq. ( 24 ). The reference images are generated using known physical parameters. Differentiation includes the SPH simulation, Lagrangian SPH–GS transfer, Gaussian covariance update, and rendering.
paragraphs.zh: 本实验评估了使用第 4.1 节中的束模型通过自动微分（AD）计算出的灵敏度的准确性。 所评估的目标是方程 (24) 中的图像失配项 𝒥 o \mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{o}}。 参考图像是使用已知的物理参数生成的。 微分过程包括 SPH 模拟、拉格朗日 SPH–GS 传递、高斯协方差更新以及渲染。

sents.en: This experiment evaluates the accuracy of sensitivities computed by automatic differentiation (AD) using the beam model in Section 4.1 .
sents.zh: 本实验评估了使用第 4.1 节中的束模型通过自动微分（AD）计算出的灵敏度的准确性。

sents.en: The evaluated objective is the image-mismatch term 𝒥 o \mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{o}} in Eq. ( 24 ).
sents.zh: 所评估的目标是方程 (24) 中的图像失配项 𝒥 o \mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{o}}。

sents.en: The reference images are generated using known physical parameters.
sents.zh: 参考图像是使用已知的物理参数生成的。

sents.en: Differentiation includes the SPH simulation, Lagrangian SPH–GS transfer, Gaussian covariance update, and rendering.
sents.zh: 微分过程包括 SPH 模拟、拉格朗日 SPH–GS 传递、高斯协方差更新以及渲染。

paragraphs.en: Directional derivatives obtained by AD are compared with central finite-difference (FD) estimates along the same unit parameter direction. Relative error is the absolute difference between the AD and FD estimates divided by the larger of their absolute magnitudes. The SPH neighbor graph, SPH–GS transfer graph, boundary masks, and Gaussian ordering remain fixed during each comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 通过自动微分（AD）获得的定向导数与沿相同单位参数方向的中心有限差分（FD）估计值进行比较。 相对误差是 AD 和 FD 估计值之间的绝对差除以两者绝对值中的较大者。 在每次比较过程中，SPH 邻域图、SPH–GS 传输图、边界掩码和高斯排序均保持不变。

sents.en: Directional derivatives obtained by AD are compared with central finite-difference (FD) estimates along the same unit parameter direction.

sents.en: The SPH neighbor graph, SPH–GS transfer graph, boundary masks, and Gaussian ordering remain fixed during each comparison.
sents.zh: 在每次比较过程中，SPH 邻域图、SPH–GS 传输图、边界掩码和高斯排序均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: The tested parameters comprise Young’s modulus for corotated-linear and neo-Hookean elasticity, the Robin stiffness field, and Kelvin–Voigt viscosity. Table 2 lists the evaluation values, at which derivatives are computed, and the reference values used to generate the images. These values differ so that sensitivities are assessed away from the reference solution. For vector-valued parameters, each listed value is assigned to all components. Static material and boundary tests use one rendered terminal frame, whereas the viscosity test uses the last five rendered frames of a transient simulation. The FD perturbation magnitude is 10 − 3 10^{-3} , except for Young’s modulus, for which 10 − 2 10^{-2} is used. The resulting relative errors are reported in Table 2 and Fig. 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 测试参数包括共旋转线性和新胡克弹性模量、罗宾刚度场以及凯尔文-沃伊特黏性。 表 2 列出了计算导数时的评估值以及用于生成图像的参考值。 这些值存在差异，以便在偏离参考解的情况下评估灵敏度。 对于向量值参数，所列出的每个值都会被分配给所有分量。 静态材料和边界测试使用一个渲染的最终帧，而黏性测试则使用瞬态模拟中最后五个渲染的帧。 有限差分扰动幅度为 10^{-3}，但弹性模量的扰动幅度为 10^{-2}。 由此得到的相对误差列于表 2 和图 4 中。

paragraphs.en: All selected checks remain below the 5 % 5\% relative-error reference. The largest discrepancy occurs for the corotated-linear Young’s-modulus check, where the rotation extracted from the deformation gradient is recomputed in the forward simulation but treated as a frozen auxiliary quantity in the backward sensitivity calculation for numerical stability. This controlled approximation does not enter the neo-Hookean material derivative, which is evaluated directly from 𝑭 \bm{F} , and the corresponding sensitivity error is therefore smaller. The Robin and Kelvin–Voigt rows show close agreement between automatic differentiation and finite differences, supporting the use of the rendered MSE objective for the inverse analyses in Section 4.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有选中的检查项均保持在 5% 相对误差参考值以下。 最大的差异出现在共旋转线性杨氏模量检查中，其中从形变梯度中提取的旋转在正向模拟中被重新计算，但在反向灵敏度计算中为保持数值稳定性而被视为冻结的辅助量。 这种受控近似不会进入 neo-Hookean 材料导数（该导数直接从 𝑭 \bm{F} 计算得出），因此相应的灵敏度误差更小。 Robin 和 Kelvin–Voigt 行显示自动微分与有限差分之间的结果高度一致，这支持在 4.2 节的逆分析中使用渲染出的 MSE 目标函数。
